description_expanded: Top Reasons to Book this Lovely Home:* Porch, Two Balconies, and Two King Master Bedrooms* 6-Seater Golf Cart available for additional $100/night (Please note: a $500 refundable deposit is required.)* Pet Friendly! (Please note: a $350 fee is required.)* Steps to the Community Pool* 4 Bikes Included* Pool with Waterfall (Seasonally heated starting in March), Hot Tub, Gazebo, Community Grilling Area, 360-observation Tower* Close by Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center* Under 1 mile to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery* Snorkel the Sea Turtle Reef-more info under Area Attractions below* Professionally Managed; 24/7 Service *This property is not available to adults Under the age of 25. No Exceptions. * **Please note, for guests that plan to bring their pet(s) there is a 2-pet limit, and will be required to pay the $350 pet fee upon booking.***We LOVE Snowbirds! Low Monthly Winter Rates*Snowbird Season runs November thru February, on a monthly basis. To prepare a qualified quote, select your arrival date (must be the 1st day of the month) and the departure date (must be the 1st day of the month). Alternate dates must be pre-approved. All monthly rentals are subject to an additional $150 cleaning fee. Please contact us with your interest and to further assist!Welcome to Our Gulfview Escape, a 4-bedroom, 3.5-bath home located in the Highland Parks community in laid-back Blue Mountain Beach. The spacious home has an open-concept kitchen, dining, and living with a large flat-screen TV and plenty of seating for everyone. Featuring a master king bedroom on the first floor and another king master bedroom with twin bunk beds on the second floor, along with two guest bedrooms on the same floor, each equipped with twin over queen bunks and additional twin beds, this charming home offers comfortable accommodation for up to 14 guests. Enjoy the sunrise while having your morning cup of coffee on the balcony, and in the evening, watch the sunset on the porch. Take the golf cart to explore all the trails down to Seaside, Watercolor, or Grayton Beach. The location is perfect, for your vacation of a lifetime at Our Gulfview Escape!Bed Setup: First Floor:Master Suite 1: King BedSecond Floor:Master Suite 2: King Bed + Twin-over-Twin bunkbed in closetGuest Bedroom 1: Twin over Queen Bunk + Twin BedGuest Bedroom 2: Twin over Queen Bunk + Twin Bed*Parking is only available for vehicles in the home's designated paved driveway. Street parking is not allowed. Violations are strictly enforced by the HOA.*Highland Parks is the newest neighborhood in Blue Mountain Beach featuring a fantastic neighborhood pool with a waterfall, hot tub, gazebo, fire pit, snack bar, and observation tower. The area is the highest point in South Walton County and is surrounded by great eateries and local eclectic shops. Highland Parks is perfectly situated between Redfish Village and Gulf Place Town Center on Hwy 30A! Enjoy dining at local favorites The Perfect Pig, Red Door, Local Catch, or Basmati's. Check out the local art scene at Justin Gaffery’s art gallery.AREA ATTRACTIONS: Seaside is a fantastic destination, most widely known for being featured in the Truman Show with Jim Carrey. It's incredible architecture has helped to make it famous but also its faithful replication of the kind of seaside town that used to be common up and down the coast. Seaside has its own Farmer's Market, post office, Repertory Theater, and neighborhood school. It boasts unique shopping, fantastic cuisine, and the incredible architecture that makes Seaside famous, there are activities for everyone; kayak rentals, bike rentals, paragliding, fishing, golfing, hiking, swimming, and tennis -- you'll find it all right here.Bike over to Blue Mountain Beach Creamery for some homemade scoops that will have your taste buds coming back! You'll have an array of dining options to choose from! The snorkelers in your group will love the new artificial reef called Sea Turtle Reef, deployed in 2017. Located just 783 feet out from the Grayton Beach State Park access, it is becoming a haven for sea life. Each of the 4 snorkeling reefs comprises 40 acres of permitted sea bottom. The Sea Turtle Reef is at a depth of 12-19 feet. We strongly recommend that snorkelers use a kayak, paddleboard, or other flotation device when visiting the snorkel reefs. Sea conditions can and do change quickly and often. Enjoy! Read less
